Is it a good or a bad thing? Will the fat lady sing? You must decide that for yourself.|Adam First hosting Wave 103 in 1986}}
'''Adam First''' is the host of [[Wave 103]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]'' and its co-host along with [[Trish Camden]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]]'', and a caller in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

He is voiced by [[Jamie Canfield]] in all three of his appearances.

==History==
===Background===
Like most DJs in [[Vice City (3D Universe)|Vice City]], Adam believes that his kind of music is the best, and fancies himself a music connoisseur. In ''Grand Theft Auto: Vice City,'' he mentions his liking for money, is a big fan of hang gliding, despises music videos because they show that the artists' looks are more important than talent, and insists that his mother had nothing to do with his personal choice of going into radio.

Similar to the situation with the earlier version of [[V-Rock (3D Universe)|V-Rock]], [[Flash FM (3D Universe)|Flash FM]] and [[Emotion 98.3]] circa 1984 in ''Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories'', Wave 103 in that game features two hosts, the [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Trish Camden]] and [[United States of America|American]] Adam First, who have conflicting personalities which lead to much argument on the radio. Adam believes that radio is better than music videos, whereas Trish's point of view is the opposite. Trish also mentions that Adam likes to wank (jerk) off to {{WP|New Order}}'s "{{WP|Blue Monday (New Order song)|Blue Monday}}".

Adam is implied to be a programmer and a mathematician, as during the intro to {{WP|Depeche Mode}}'s "{{WP|Everything Counts}}", he mentions having written a program on his [[Fruit (3D Universe)|Fruit LC]] computer where a triangle flies across the screen and turns into pixels, and he favorably compares {{WP|Heaven 17}}'s song "{{WP|Penthouse and Pavement}}" to calculus.

Adam makes a cameo appearance in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'' as a caller to the conspiracy theory show ''[[Area 53]]'' on the [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|West Coast Talk Radio]] in [[1992]]. He says that while hang-gliding in [[Bone County (3D Universe)|Bone County]], he saw a man at a trailer compound performing strange rituals with a [[Domestobot]]. The show host [[Marvin Trill]] (who is later revealed to be the man that Adam saw) tells him to get a real hobby, and hangs up.

In ''[[Grand Theft Auto V]]'', he is one of the honored celebrities on the [[Vinewood Walk of Fame]].
